attributes.action: Regulate bot bulk-buying and resale scalping of high-demand consumer goods
attributes.additional_details: Heatwave demand has sold out air conditioners in minutes, letting scalpers relist stock at inflated prices. eBay UK alone has 116 new listings priced 40-300% above RRP (£540-£660 vs £770-£2,050). Resold units often lose warranty cover and bypass F-gas certified installation rules, risking buyers' safety. We ask Government to: ban bulk-buying bots, require marketplaces to act on repeat scalpers, and cap resale markups on essential seasonal goods, with real penalties for breaches.
attributes.background: This summer's heatwaves have turned essential cooling equipment into a target for opportunistic resellers, pricing out the families and vulnerable people who need it most. We call on the Government to crack down on scalping and hold resellers to account.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this open petition:
'Ban the use of bots to bulk-buy products & reselling them at inflated prices'
